title: The Augmented Forest
abstract:
As AI genies make programming more joyful in some ways, more fraught in others, how can we as individuals & teams adapt?

How can we track a rapidly changing landscape of tools & still get stuff done?

How can we communicate our new powers, strengths & weaknesses, to those without direct experience of programming?

The Forest & Desert is a dialectical framing of software development as either resource-rich & resource replenishing or continually near starvation.

The genie promises to intensify both experiences.

speakers.name: Kent Beck
speakers.role_company: Creator of Extreme Programming, Co-authored the Agile Manifesto
